title: DeepSeek Elastic Compute (DSec): Sandbox Infrastructure for Effective Agentic Training at Scale
summary: DeepSeek introduces DSec (DeepSeek Elastic Compute), a sandbox infrastructure designed to support agentic training at scale. The system provides isolated, elastic compute environments for training AI agents that interact with tools and execute code, addressing the infrastructure challenges of running large-scale agentic reinforcement learning and evaluation workloads.
